question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed memory role-slot taxonomy as durable public config/API surface, or keep the single memory slot and solve coexistence through narrower plugin-specific seams?
rationale: Current main still has the reported single-slot limitation, but adding role slots creates new public config, per-agent semantics, and migration behavior that automation should not choose without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Review and sponsor the role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical fix path, focusing maintainer review on taxonomy, compatibility, doctor migration, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow to targeted coexistence repairs
options.body: Keep the single memory slot and split out smaller fixes for dreaming, diagnostics, and prompt-section coexistence without adding broad role slots yet.

options.title: Reject multi-slot memory for now
options.body: Close or supersede the issue after documenting the supported single-slot model and expected plugin workaround path.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical fix path, focusing maintainer review on taxonomy, compatibility, doctor migration, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting config/plugin product decision rather than a narrow code defect, and `steipete` is the strongest available adjacent product/code routing signal from the inspected history.
